name: forgebench
description: Onboard a repository's AI agents and MCP servers to forgebench through the hosted forgebench MCP server: scan locally, review the server-side diff, then plan and apply with workspace default budgets. Agent keys are only ever revealed in the browser.

forgebench_url.title: Forgebench URL
forgebench_url.description: Base URL of your Forgebench deployment, without a trailing slash. The session sync hooks upload to it.

forgebench_cli_path.title: Forgebench CLI path
forgebench_cli_path.description: The forgebench CLI the session sync hooks run: a command name on PATH or an absolute path.

sync.title: Sync coding sessions
sync.description: Upload this tool's coding sessions to Forgebench. Off: the hooks exit before reading a transcript or starting the CLI. MCP is unaffected.

mcp_url.title: Forgebench MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Not used by the bundled MCP server, which always connects to https://api.forgebench.ai/mcp. Kept only so existing managed settings that set it stay valid.
